summary: This bill expands family and medical leave eligibility by removing the hours-of-service requirement for part-time workers and prohibits employers from discriminating against employees based on their work hours, requiring employers to offer additional work to existing employees before hiring new ones.

scores.thoughts: This bill significantly expands protections and benefits for part-time workers, including easier access to FMLA leave, protection against discrimination based on hours worked, and requirements for employers to offer additional hours to existing employees before hiring new ones. These provisions generally strengthen worker rights and impose new regulations on employers, aligning with the 'more labor laws' end of the spectrum.
